scope: Code-only boundary tests. Controlled positive grammar and trusted allowed records; adapter rebuilds canonical host audience view. Only resolved read/explain compiles v0.1 programs and runs existing kernel then release-validating realizer. Unresolved has no text; no Ask argument/path and no Compare. No experiment runner/data/model dependency, training, GPU, spend, network or capability claim. No shared schema/kernel/realizer changes.
semantic_guard: Every admitted form retains requested kind/field and ordered subject/operand refs. Model kind/field/left/right disagreements fail closed before program construction/kernel/renderer; no model choice is overwritten. For read/explain, right may be absent or None and is preserved; any non-null right rejects.
temporal_guard: Every selected field must exist and have a nonempty scope equal to model temporal_scope. Dated forms additionally require that evidence scope equal parsed YYYY-MM. Undated forms require model scope to match active evidence. Missing/stale model or evidence scope rejects before construction/kernel/renderer; no broader date grammar or Compare release.

tests.guards: Wrong left/right/model scope stay unreleased and invoke neither adapter program constructor, kernel nor renderer. Positive read/explain with right=None still checks and renders; compare remains unsupported.

validation_scaffold_overlap.limitation: These three admitted scaffolds verbatim match the iterative development-validation templates. That data cannot support a transfer/generalization claim for this grammar. This receipt is code-only, not a capability evaluation.
